The '''whorrwaarr''' were a [[Giantism|giant]] variety of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] found on the [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="SWI145" /> in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] inhabitants of Kashyyyk had domesticated the whorrwaarr and made them carry loads.<ref name="SWI145" />

==Behind the scenes==
The whorrwaarr first appeared in a conceptual sketch drawn by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. They were described as "bantha-like creatures," and it appears that [[George Lucas]] himself had invented their name.<ref name="MESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> In [[2013]], the unfinished sketch was completed by [[Paul Bateman]] for the [[McQuarrie Revisited]] segment of the [[Star Wars Insider 145|145th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="SWI145" /> [[Leland Chee]], the Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]] at [[Lucasfilm]], has stated that McQuarrie's works completed by Bateman are still considered concept art, and thus not part of the official [[Canon|continuity]].<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/400363017012912128|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@reeldefiction We'd still treat it as concept art.|archivedate=20190722074522}}</ref>
